issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5/2.0 Appendix B — Errors and Messaging — Message: severities Trace/Message/Warning are 'expected to be made available to the calling environment'
issues.evidence: Informational message channel (Trace/Message/Warning surfacing) remains unimplemented — inherent to a translate-to-SQL engine with no logging channel; non-Error severities correctly continue evaluation and pass source through on both engine paths. Same classification as the SKEPTIC launch (CQL-22 QA-001). Official fixtures (CqlErrorsAndMessagingOperatorsTest.xml 4/4) do not pin the informational channel.
issues.root_cause: Design: translate-to-SQL engine has no message/log sink
issues.resolution: Documented, not forced; carried forward as INTENDED
